name: Travis Davis
occupation: Greybull chief of police (Lovell Chronicle, April 9, 2026)
background: Travis Davis of Big Horn County ran in the August 2026 Republican primary for county sheriff and lost. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he was Greybull's chief of police and was one of three candidates interviewed for the interim sheriff appointment in April 2026, and that he finished third in the primary with 540 votes.
